messages:
zoe: Odd auth edge-case: when using AsyncClient with automatic retries + env-file rotation, retries sometimes carry the _new_ env key even though the original request started with the explicit api_key passed to the client. Repro below.

zoe: Minimal repro: create client_b = AsyncClient(api_key=\"sk-b\", max_retries=2) and client_a = AsyncClient() (env watcher). Make a request from B that triggers a retry (server 503). If the watcher rotates the env key between attempt 0 and retry 1, retry goes out with rotated env key, not sk-b.

mark: hmm that suggests the retry path resolves auth headers at send-time using global provider state instead of the immutable per-request header captured at first attempt.

li: can you paste the patched pseudo-repro?

zoe: snippet: 
```py
async def send_with_retry(client):
    # client constructed with explicit api_key
    await client.generate(\"x\" )  # simulated 503 on first attempt, succeeds on retry

# concurrently flip env file between attempts
```

zoe: Observed logs: attempt=0 Authorization=sk-b, attempt=1 Authorization=env:sk-new.

mark: workaround: disable file watcher in processes that do retries, or set client.retry_mode to capture headers early. But that's not great UX.

li: fix idea: when enqueueing a retry, capture effective Authorization header (or a signed token) on the original attempt and use it for subsequent attempts of that request, unless the user explicitly wants live rotation.

mark: agree. Also ensure AsyncClient.bind_auth_header() exists in request pipeline so middlewares can freeze auth per-request. Add a unit test that fakes a transient 503 and invokes watcher callback before retry dispatch. Put test at devex/tests/test_retry_auth_freeze.py.

deploy-bot: Created issue #4212: \"retries adopt rotated env key instead of preserving per-request auth\" and added label devex/bug. Assigned to @li.

li: taking this. plan: (1) make retry logic attach frozen headers to RetryContext, (2) ensure explicit api_key sets a per-client provider that yields immutable header blobs, (3) add test + types. Will open draft PR and link.

zoe: thanks! also note in migration: users who depend on live-rotation-on-retry should opt into AuthProvider.live_rotation=True. Marking thread blocked on PR review.
